findings.explanation: The new bulk price update endpoint (`/bulk-price`) in `app/routes/items.py` uses `@require_login`, allowing any authenticated user (such as a customer with role rank 0) to update the prices of all items in the store. Other item modification and management endpoints require staff or admin roles (e.g. `@require_role("staff")` or `@require_role("admin")`).
findings.claim: The bulk-price endpoint only requires login instead of the staff or admin role needed for modifying prices.

arguments.summary: The PR adds a bulk price update endpoint (`/bulk-price`) that allows any logged-in user (including customers) to modify all item prices because it uses `@require_login` instead of restricting access to staff or admins.

findings.explanation: The new bulk price update endpoint (`/bulk-price`) in `app/routes/items.py` uses `@require_login`, allowing any authenticated user (such as a customer with role rank 0) to update the prices of all items in the store. Other item modification and management endpoints require staff or admin roles (e.g. `@require_role("staff")` or `@require_role("admin")`).
